_note: The Pruitts' storm shelter (Session 16; DESIGN.md 'Storm shelter'; encounters/StormShelter.js, render/StormShelterProps.js). Aaron: Earl dug it himself, so it's small and a bit shabby. Positions are metres in the shelter's frame (world/clearingFrame.js: walking in from home, x to your right, z ahead, the clearing's centre at 0, 0). yaw: degrees from ahead toward the right. hatch: the steel hatch in its timber collar on a low mound (w across, d along; the hinge is on its far side). sigil: Night 1's, beside the hatch (FirstDay plants it there). earl: where Earl stands (the zombie variant 'earl'; Aaron, Session 13). horde: where the twelve stand, round the hatch. room: the room below, under the hatch: its centre (x, z), half sizes (hx across, hz along), depth (its floor this far under the hatch's ground), height; ladder: where it comes down (room-local x, z). Everything in it is room-local (x across, z along from the room's centre). searches: hold-X spots, up top or below ('below': true). photos: the corkboard of trail-cam photos (look only).
